info.title: Privacy Policy
info.e2e: Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. Server administrators can read messages through the database.
info.guest: Guest accounts are deleted 30 minutes after the last message in their conversation (or after creation if no message was sent).
info.retention: Conversations are deleted after 1 month of inactivity.
info.contact: Sharing contact information as a guest is voluntary. It is deleted together with the guest account.
info.intro: This policy explains what data pmess collects, how it is used, and how long it is kept. pmess is a small, independently run messaging project, so we aim to keep this short and plain.

p: If you sign in with Google, we receive your Google account identifier, email address and name. We use the name only as your initial display name.
When you set up your profile, we store the username and display name you choose.
When you chat, we store the messages you send, the conversations you are part of, and which messages have been read.
If you continue as a guest, we create a temporary account without any personal information.
Your data is used only to run the service: signing you in, letting other people find you by username, and delivering your messages. We do not sell your data, show ads, or share it with third parties.

Messages are not end-to-end encrypted. They are stored on our server, and server administrators can read them through the database. Please do not share passwords, financial details or other sensitive information on pmess.
Conversations are deleted after 1 month of inactivity.
Guest accounts are deleted 30 minutes after the last message in their conversation, or 30 minutes after creation if no message was sent.
Sharing contact information as a guest is voluntary. It is deleted together with the guest account.
We use cookies only to sign you in and keep you signed in. Your theme and language preferences are stored in your browser. We do not use tracking or analytics cookies.
You can change your display name in Settings, and you can delete your account at any time. Deleting your account removes your profile, conversations and messages.
If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page.
